geometry.plane: Top-down after fixed arm roll +90 deg: plot (x,y) = (-world Y, world X), relative to node0; height omitted.

body_model.note: Housing footprint rectangle plus the rolled CAD wedge connecting it to node0; omit plate.

formula: f_k(x,y,D) = w_0k + sum_j w_jk exp(-0.5 sum_i ((v_i-o_i)/s_i-c_ji)^2) - threshold_k; band iff f_k >= 0
semantics: Empirical recorded-success regions, not a grasp solver or proof that unobserved positions are impossible. No extrapolation.
